targets.outcome_quote: Neither of the experiments reported here revealed evidence of depletion of self-regulatory resources. Our failure to replicate the findings of prior studies was unexpected, and is puzzling.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly describe both experiments as failing to replicate. Possible masking explanations are limitations, not a verdict that the attempts cannot adjudicate.
